svg.title: FIG-03 Current configuration and generation
svg.desc: one authored TOML assembly; SoC / CPU / route facts; Board wiring and provenance; strict TOML fields -> frozen AuthoredAssembly; strict field / mode / resource / identity checks; immutable named IR: each decision stored once; SoC Construction: static definitions and cold calls; transactional generation and atomic publish; static instances / factory / config / budgets / resolved.json; CMake: sole software target graph; Ninja: compile / link / resource checks; ELF / BIN / map / resource reports; rejected input or generation failure; invalidate owned bundle, no partial outputs; sole assembly input; unresolved selections; silicon capability; Board authorization; validated; named fields; render binding C bytes; one-way JSON / config / memory projection; atomic publish; configuration and generated sources; execute target graph; actual artifacts of this execution; invalid syntax / fields; emission failure; invalid / conflict / input changed; generation or publish failure; invalidate owned outputs only
